nodes.label: Domain docs consumption for engineering skills
nodes.rationale: Skills should read CONTEXT.md and docs/adr before exploring so names and architecture stay aligned with recorded decisions. Missing files are not a gap to flag. Proposed changes that conflict with an ADR must be surfaced instead of silently overridden, and new wording should prefer the glossary.

nodes.label: CONTEXT.md glossary
nodes.rationale: The repo is a single-context repo whose glossary is CONTEXT.md. Skills and plans should prefer those terms. ADR 0015 records glossary additions for diacritic marking, diacritic transfer, unaligned token, and the sc exception. Slice 2 of the lexicon work is expected to update the glossary with domain language only.
